The [[Emerald Blade]] is a sword with an intricate emerald design set in and above the hilt.

==Acquisition==
'''[[Guild Wars Eye of the North|Eye of the North]]'''
*[[Catacombs of Kathandrax]]
**[[Chest of Kathandrax]]

*[[Zaishen Chest]] (very rare drop)

==Dye==
This item cannot be [[dye]]d.

== Notes ==
[[Image:Emerald Blade Concept Art.jpg|right|thumb|The concept art for this sword]]
* Many players confuse this weapon with the [[Emerald Edge]], due to the similarity of names.

* Other weapons with this appearance:
**{{w}} [[Silver Edge]] ([[Unique item|unique]])

*The effect of ambient lighting on the appearance of this sword can be quite dramatic:
[[Image:EmeraldBladeLights.jpg|left|thumb|300px|<small>From the top: in the shade (Kryta), semi-shaded (Istan), fully lit (Istan) and fully shaded (Kaineng City)</small>]]{{clear}}

== Trivia ==
*This weapon is based on the honorable mention design by ''Findur Calenardhon'' from the [[Design-a-Weapon (2007)|Design-a-Weapon Contest]] held in 2007.
